# /crav1-open-pr

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From commit to merge](../../from-commit.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-open-pr/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Open a pull request for the current change branch (push with explicit yes).

Push the change branch only after an explicit yes, then open one pull request (no merge, no commit). Body is What / why, Spec links, Verify, and a Work item section when `work-item.md` exists. On Windows, a multi-line Azure DevOps description is passed as `--description "@<file>"` (UTF-8 without BOM). May name [`/crav1-review-pr`](crav1-review-pr.md) and does not run it. Next explicit ask to merge is [`/crav1-merge-pr`](crav1-merge-pr.md).

## Runs when

Commits exist; want a pull request. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: The change branch, the spec, and `verify.md`.

Reads the change branch, the spec folder, `verify.md`, and `work-item.md` when it exists.

## Writes

In short: A push of the change branch and one pull request, after an explicit yes.

Writes one pull request after an explicit yes to push.

## Does not

Leaves new commits and the merge alone.

Limits and exceptions: names [`/crav1-review-pr`](crav1-review-pr.md) and [`/crav1-merge-pr`](crav1-merge-pr.md) and does not run them.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-review-pr`](crav1-review-pr.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Commit and pull request. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).
